description:
## Features

### YouTube Music
- **Android Auto, downloaded playlists:** Library now has a `Downloaded playlists` folder next to Playlists. It lists the playlists saved with the built-in downloader, plus `Not in a playlist`, with their tracks. Playing a track starts it in the right place and queues the whole playlist in order, all without a network connection. After a cold start with no data the folder is still reachable. Empty playlists are hidden. The folder follows `Download in app`; the new Miscellaneous setting `Android Auto downloaded playlists` is on by default.
  - The track rows have no artwork in the car's list. The Now playing screen shows the cover.
  - Needs YouTube Music 9.15 or newer, like the rest of the Android Auto patch; 8.x skips it with a warning.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.26.0...v1.27.0)
